results.original_text: As a site editor, I want to have pretty good control over how the article, so that articles are visually appealing.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to manage the visual layout of articles effectively so that I can enhance their aesthetic appeal, aiming for a 30% increase in reader engagement metrics.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editors should be able to customize article formatting options (font styles, colors, and layouts) with a user-friendly interface, achieving changes within 2 minutes for 90% of tasks.
- At least 85% of readers should report an improvement in visual appeal in a post-article feedback survey conducted within one month of implementation.
- The system must ensure that all formatting changes are saved correctly without loss of data in at least 95% of attempts.

Test Outline:
- Measure the time taken by editors to apply formatting changes, ensuring that 90% of tasks are completed within the 2-minute timeframe.
- Analyze reader feedback from surveys to confirm that at least 85% of respondents perceive an improvement in visual appeal.
- Conduct tests on the save functionality to verify that formatting changes persist reliably, aiming for a ≥ 95% success rate.

User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over article formatting and layout so that I can enhance the visual appeal of articles, resulting in a 30% increase in reader engagement.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editors should be able to customize article elements (fonts, images, and layouts) using an intuitive interface with at least 95% usability satisfaction among users.
- Articles must maintain a consistent visual style, with ≥ 90% adherence to predefined design guidelines.
- An increase in time spent on articles by readers should be measured, targeting a minimum of 25% improvement post-implementation.

Test Outline:
- Conduct usability testing to evaluate the ease of use of formatting tools, aiming for at least 95% positive feedback from editors.
- Review a sample of published articles to ensure they adhere to the design guidelines, with ≥ 90% compliance.
- Analyze site analytics to measure changes in average time spent by readers on articles before and after enhancements.

history.text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over the article formatting and layout so that I can ensure each article is visually appealing and engages readers, leading to a minimum of 30% increase in reader retention.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The editor interface should allow at least 10 different customizable formatting options for text, images, and layouts.
- Articles should load with a visually appealing design in less than 5 seconds for 95% of users.
- User surveys should indicate that at least 85% of readers find the articles visually appealing after the new formatting options are implemented.

Test Outline:
- Evaluate the editor interface to confirm the availability of ≥ 10 formatting options for articles.
- Measure the loading time of articles to ensure they meet the ≤ 5 seconds criterion for 95% of users.
- Conduct post-implementation surveys to gather feedback on the visual appeal of articles, targeting an ≥ 85% satisfaction rate.

results.original_text: I want a search bar on the top of the page.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a user, I want a search bar located at the top of the page so that I can quickly initiate searches from any part of the site, enhancing my navigation efficiency by at least 30%.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar must be accessible and functional on all pages within 100% of user sessions.
- Users should be able to perform a search with the search bar within 2 clicks, maintaining a success rate of ≥ 95%.
- At least 85% of users should express satisfaction with the search bar's visibility and ease of use in a feedback survey conducted after implementation.

Test Outline:
- Verify the search bar's presence and functionality on various pages by navigating through the site during testing.
- Track the number of clicks required to perform a search, ensuring that it remains ≤ 2 clicks for 95% of users.
- Conduct a user satisfaction survey post-launch to gather feedback on the search bar's visibility and usability.

User Story:
As a user, I want a prominently placed search bar at the top of the page so that I can quickly locate information, enhancing my navigation efficiency by at least 30%.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar should be visible on all pages, with a 100% accessibility rate for users.
- Users should be able to initiate a search within 2 clicks on 95% of the pages.
- At least 85% of users should express satisfaction with the search bar's location and functionality in a post-implementation survey.

Test Outline:
- Verify the visibility of the search bar on all pages by conducting a thorough review of the site layout.
- Measure the number of clicks required to initiate a search across various pages to ensure it meets the ≤ 2 clicks requirement.
- Gather user feedback through surveys to assess satisfaction levels, targeting ≥ 85% positive responses regarding the search bar.

As a user, I want a prominently placed search bar at the top of the page so that I can quickly locate content, enhancing my navigation efficiency by at least 30%.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar must be visible on 100% of pages, ensuring users can access it without scrolling.
- Users should be able to perform a search and receive results within 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
- At least 85% of users should report improved navigation satisfaction in a post-implementation survey.

Test Outline:
- Verify the visibility of the search bar across all pages to confirm it appears without the need for scrolling.
- Measure response times for search queries, ensuring that 95% are processed within the 2-second timeframe.
- Conduct a user satisfaction survey after implementation to assess navigation improvements, targeting ≥ 85% positive feedback.
